versions.changelog:
- Clarified the rule: final line now states the agent is on the negative side, not just a "con agent".
- No file changes detected; this is a minor update to the skill description and guidelines only.

- Output format: Updated heading and instruction for the core rebuttal summary to clarify focus on logical or factual flaws.
- Rules: Added explicit guidance that the agent must maintain a firm, opposition stance as a con agent.
- No functional changes to logic or behavior; documentation only.

Initial release of the "debate-con" skill.

- Introduces an opposition (con) debater agent to rigorously challenge arguments, plans, and proposals.
- Breaks down user arguments into logical components and systematically identifies flaws: logic gaps, data issues, risky assumptions, implementation blind spots, and opportunity costs.
- Provides a clear, hierarchical rebuttal format with specific examples and pointed follow-up questions.
- Responds in either Chinese or English, strictly focusing on critique—never agreement or flattery.
